cards.card_text: And then one more: "Look, they are even putting the branch to their nose!"
cards.verse_text: “Son of man,” He said to me, “do you see this? Is it not enough for the house of Judah to commit the abominations they are practicing here, that they must also fill the land with violence and continually provoke Me to anger? Look, they are even putting the branch to their nose!
